metadata.title: Mass modelling globular clusters in the Gaia era: a method comparison using mock data from an $N$-body simulation of M4

notes: No eligible stars: the paper models mock observations of the globular cluster M 4 (T:p1-b5), which is not an individual star. Its "potential escapers" (T:p6-b2) are described as energetically unbound from the cluster while still interacting with the Galactic tidal field; the paper does not identify them as unbound from the Milky Way or as Galactic unbound candidates.
